name: lilygo-t-eth-elite
title: LilyGO T-ETH-ELite
notes: ESP32-S3-WROOM-1 N16R8 (16 MB flash, 8 MB octal PSRAM). Soldered W5500: SCLK 48, MOSI 21, MISO 47, CS 45, INT 14; its reset line isn't wired (software reset only). TF slot on the shield SPI bus: SCLK 10, MOSI 11, MISO 9, CS 12, shared with a LoRa/LTE shield's radio (CS 40). Green LED on GPIO38. PoE (802.3af) built in; keep the OTG switch off on PoE unless the USB-C port must power something. CS GPIO45 is a strapping pin. Pins: T-ETH-ELite schematic (2024-05), LilyGO utilities.h; LilyGO's ESP-IDF gateway firmware runs Ethernet on it.
